verses.75:16: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ

meaning: The root حرك primarily means "to move" or "to be in motion," the opposite of stillness. It can also describe hitting or hurting someone's shoulder/neck, or, less commonly, being incapable of coition.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
